copy.html:
If you hope to win a life changing jackpot, the Millionaire for Life Lotto could be the lottery for you. It's a quick and exciting way to try to improve your life, and it's really very simple to play!

The cash option jackpot is set at USD$18-Million, with a second prize of USD$2.2 Million, each and every draw! The Millionaire for Life Lotto draw happens every day of the week at 11:15 p.m. (Eastern Time).

What Could You Win?

There are nine prize divisions in total, including a Cash Option jackpot of USD$18-Million and second prize of over USD$2-Million!

Do you have the lucky ticket? Be sure to check the latest Millionaire for Life Lotto results, or look out for an email from LottosOnline to confirm your winnings!

Playing Millionaire for Life Lotto Online

Do you want to win millions? Playing Millionaire for Life Lotto online is simple - here's how to do it with LottosOnline!

To buy your Millionaire for Life Lotto lottery ticket online, simply choose 5 numbers from 1 to 58, and one Millionaire Ball from 1 to 5. If you can't decide, use our Quick Pick random number generator.

Once you have placed your Millionaire for Life Lotto entry and paid using your prefered payment method, our local ticket purchasing agents will purchase the official lottery ticket on your behalf. You don't have to do a thing.

You will receive email confirmation of your lottery ticket purchase. Your official ticket will be held in a secure location until after the draw, when it will be checked and verified for any winnings. If you have won, we will let you know the good news immediately!

You've Won! What Happens Next?

Have you won a prize? Big or small, your winnings will immediately be credited to your LottosOnline Winnings Balance. We'll let you know how much you have won via email - so don't worry if you have forgotten to check the latest Millionaire for Life Lotto results.

Receiving your winning via LottosOnline is simple and straightforward. Your winnings will be credited to your LottosOnline Winnings Balance straight away. Just log in to check your Winnings Balance, and decide how to claim it! Either arrange a transfer to your bank account or convert it into more Account Balance to buy more tickets. It really is that simple!

Please note: Prizes are paid as the cash value option. The Millionaire for Life lottery Jackpot and the second prize totals are displayed on that basis.

Fun Facts About the Millionaire for Life Lotto

Did you know?

  • The game is brand new - it was launched in February 2026.
  • The Millionaire for Life lottery is drawn every single day of the week
